description: Insert characters into a character list. Only the first l characters of oline and the first p characters of nl are used. Return the list obtained by inserting the first p characters of nl into the first l characters of oline at position atPos (0-based). The result has length l + p: its first atPos characters are oline[0..atPos-1], the next p characters are nl[0..p-1], and the last l - atPos characters are oline[atPos..l-1]. The inputs satisfy l <= length of oline, p <= length of nl and atPos <= l, where l, p and atPos are non-negative integers.

dafny.spec:
method insert(oline: seq<char>, l: nat, nl: seq<char>, p: nat, atPos: nat) returns (result: seq<char>)
  requires l <= |oline|
  requires p <= |nl|
  requires atPos <= l
  ensures |result| == l + p
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < p ==> result[atPos + i] == nl[i]
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < atPos ==> result[i] == oline[i]
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < l - atPos ==> result[atPos + p + i] == oline[atPos + i]
